subject: [Intake] HeliosX-2 variant: sandbox hold & compatibility checklist
messages:
From: Sam Ortega <sam@helios.ai>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Cc: Helios AI Intake <intake@helios.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: HeliosX-2 intake — weights + perf report attached

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking this. Attaching the HeliosX-2 variant bits for initial intake — weights bundle and a short inference report from our perf team. High level: this is a 13B derivative trained with an alternate tokenizer; we flagged potential KV-cache differences during eval.

Request: can Redwood run a quick compatibility check in a sandbox (staging) and let us know if there are any obvious tokenizer/kv-cache regressions or memory layout issues before we push for a public intake? If possible, we'd like a temporary hold on rolling the variant into any live pools until the check completes.

Attachments:
- HeliosX-2-weights.tar.gz (1.4GB)
- HeliosX-2-inference-report.pdf

Happy to hop on a short call if that's easier.

—Sam
Sam Ortega
PM, Model Ops — Helios AI
sam@helios.ai

From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
To: Sam Ortega <sam@helios.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HeliosX-2 intake — weights + perf report attached

Thanks Sam — I downloaded the artifacts and skimmed the report. A few quick asks so we can scope the sandbox check properly:

1) Which tokenizer (name+version) did you use? The note about alternate tokenizer is important for our tokenization/eval harness.
2) Can you confirm the sequence-length distribution from your perf run (p95, p99 lengths)?
3) Any custom ops or fused kernels in that weights bundle? If so we need a build checklist.

Internally I'll request a temporary staging hold for HeliosX-2 variant adoption until compat checks complete. Laura — can you own the staging hold and schedule a 2-day sandbox run? Aditya — can you confirm the compat checklist below is available on your side, or note gaps: tokenizer mapping, KV cache layout verification, quantization simulation (+4bit path), and padding/endianness checks.

Goal: produce a short compatibility summary (OK / action items) and recommend either a temporary flavor (quantized-friendly) or a rollback plan.

If you have a preferred time for a 30m sync with Helios eng, propose windows Wed/Thu.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Principal PM, Model Intake — Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Ortega <sam@helios.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HeliosX-2 intake — weights + perf report attached

Chloe / team — I can provision a sandbox job for 48 hours starting Thu morning. I'll open a provisional staging hold in the intake tracker (HUBSPOT-67821) and mark the variant as HOLD:staging. That should prevent automated rollout policies from selecting HeliosX-2 for any live pools.

Aditya — quick note on scope: please run the following during the sandbox run and paste results back into the tracker:
- Tokenizer roundtrip test (generate -> detokenize -> retokenize) for 10K diverse prompts.
- KV cache address/content continuity test across chunked generation.
- 4-bit quant sim in the runner with sample latencies for seq=128/512.
- Memory spikes / OOM reproduction with pinned batch sizes.

Also flag any weird tokenizer tokens (out-of-vocab) that cause large generation regressions. If we see anything blocking, we'll coordinate a temporary variant isolation (no traffic) and request remediation from Helios.

Sam — can you share the tokenizer artifact (tokenizer.json or tokenizer-spec link) before Wed EOD? That will help us avoid wasted runs.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Staff Engineer, Model Serving — Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Ortega <sam@helios.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HeliosX-2 intake — weights + perf report attached

Thanks — quick engineering notes from my side:

- We have tokenizer roundtrip harness ready; if Helios provides tokenizer.json I can run it overnight.
- KV cache layout: initial cursory scan of weight schema suggests a non-standard cache key ordering (they included an additional prefix dimension). That will likely require a lightweight shim in our KV adapter.
- Quantization: 4-bit sim will run but expect some accuracy delta; I'll produce a compare-vs-baseline report.
- No custom fused kernels were found in the tarball, but the tokenizer mismatch is the real risk.

Requesting exception: if the tokenizer mismatch proves non-trivial, I propose a temporary "variant aliasing" approach: serve HeliosX-2 under an isolated model-id in staging with a compatibility shim and prevent promotion to shared pools until remediation. Need Laura to apply the HOLD tag and for Product to approve the isolation.

I can start the shim prototype after we have tokenizer.json.

- Aditya
Aditya Rao
Software Engineer, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference

From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Ortega <sam@helios.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HeliosX-2 intake — weights + perf report attached

All — quick update and next steps:

1) Sam — thanks, the tokenizer.json arrived this morning and Aditya kicked off the roundtrip run.
2) Laura — please add HOLD:staging on HeliosX-2 in the intake tracker now (done). Also please schedule the sandbox from Thu 18:00 to Sat 18:00 PST; include the quant sim and KV continuity tests.
3) Aditya — start the shim prototype concurrently and post progress to the tracker. If shim is needed, we'll move to a temporary isolated variant-id and mark it DO NOT PROMOTE.

We'll treat this as an exception flow: staging hold + isolated variant if needed. Product approves the temporary isolation for up to 14 days to allow Helios to remediate. After that period we'll either remove the hold (if compatibility is resolved) or advise Helios on a formal remediation plan.

Sam — we'll send a short summary (OK / action items) by Mon EOD next week. If Helios wants a daily stand during the sandbox window, propose times and we'll try to align.

Thanks everyone — I'll update HUBSPOT-67821 and the Drive link with results.

Chloe
Chloe Martin
Principal PM, Model Intake — Redwood Inference
